items.source: Actually invoke the afterCommit methods of the given Spring TransactionSynchronization objects.
items.translation: 实际上调用给定 Spring 事务同步对象的afterCommit方法。

items.source: Actually invoke the afterCompletion methods of the given Spring TransactionSynchronization objects.
items.translation: 实际上调用给定 Spring 事务同步对象的afterCompletion方法。

items.source: Trigger afterCommit callbacks on all currently registered synchronizations.
items.translation: 触发所有当前注册的同步的afterCommit回调。

items.source: Trigger afterCompletion callbacks on all currently registered synchronizations.
items.translation: 触发所有当前注册的同步的afterCompletion回调。

items.source: Trigger beforeCommit callbacks on all currently registered synchronizations.
items.translation: 触发所有当前已注册的同步的beforeCommit回调。

items.source: Trigger beforeCompletion callbacks on all currently registered synchronizations.
items.translation: 触发所有当前注册的同步的beforeCompletion回调。

items.source: Trigger flush callbacks on all currently registered synchronizations.
items.translation: 触发所有当前注册的同步的flush回调。

items.source:
Check whether the given resource transaction manager refers to the given
(underlying) resource factory.
items.translation: 检查给定的资源事务管理器是否引用了给定的（底层）资源工厂。

items.source:
Unwrap the given resource handle if necessary; otherwise return
the given handle as-is.
items.translation: 如有必要，则解除给定资源句柄的包装；否则按原样返回该句柄。

items.source: RuntimeException - if thrown by a flush callback
items.translation: RuntimeException - 如果由 flush 回调抛出

items.source: RuntimeException - if thrown by a beforeCommit callback
items.translation: RuntimeException - 如果由 beforeCommit 回调抛出

items.source: RuntimeException - if thrown by a afterCommit callback
items.translation: RuntimeException - 如果由 afterCommit 回调抛出

items.translation: completionStatus - 根据 TransactionSynchronization 接口中的常量确定的完成状态

items.source: Utility methods for triggering specific TransactionSynchronization callback methods on all currently registered synchronizations.
items.translation: 用于触发所有当前注册的同步器上特定TransactionSynchronization回调方法的实用方法。

items.source: readOnly - whether the transaction is defined as read-only transaction
items.translation: readOnly - 事务是否定义为只读事务
